name: Opportunity cost
definition: Value of the best forgone alternative use of a resource; in appraisal, inputs valued at shadow prices
estimable_from: market or shadow prices of the inputs used
sections: 01 Microeconomics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Compensated (Hicksian) price elasticity of demand
definition: Own-price elasticity at constant utility; Slutsky: ε^h = ε^m + s·η
estimable_from: demand system (AIDS) on household expenditure surveys

name: Income elasticity of demand
definition: η = ∂ln q / ∂ln y
sections: 01 Microeconomics; 02 Demand Analysis; 15 Consumer Demand and Market Intelligence; 15 Pricing, Markups, and Profitability
keywords: Income effect; Income elasticity; Income gradients; Income elasticity of demand

name: Consumer surplus
definition: CS = ∫_p^p_max q(p) dp: area under the demand curve above the price paid

name: Producer surplus
definition: PS = ∫_0^q (p − MC(x)) dx: revenue above marginal cost
estimable_from: revenue minus variable cost from accounts

name: Price elasticity of demand
definition: ε = ∂ln q / ∂ln p
estimable_from: log-log demand regression with price instruments on transactions
sections: 01 Microeconomics; 02 Demand Analysis; 15 Consumer Demand and Market Intelligence; 15 Pricing, Markups, and Profitability; 26 Urban Needs Identification
keywords: Elasticity; Demand elasticity; Price sensitivity; Consumer price sensitivity; Price elasticity of demand; Demand elasticity by user group
notes: generic keyword; income and cross-price elasticities are separate ids; alt: Van Westendorp price sensitivity meter; by user group

name: Transaction cost share
definition: Fees, taxes, search and legal costs of an exchange as a share of its value
estimable_from: statutory fee and tax schedules applied to sale prices
sections: 01 Microeconomics; 03 Land Economics and Land Markets
notes: alt: transaction-sector share of GDP (Wallis & North 1986)

name: External cost
definition: Unpriced cost imposed on third parties: Σ impacts × unit damage values
source: Pigou 1920; EC Handbook on the External Costs of Transport 2019
estimable_from: impact pathway: emissions × dose–response × unit values
sections: 01 Microeconomics; 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 05 Urban Freight and Curb Management; 06 Environmental Economics and Sustainability
keywords: Externalities; External cost; External costs; Freight externalities; Environmental externalities

name: Travel time index
definition: TTI = peak-period travel time / free-flow travel time
source: Schrank, Eisele & Lomax 2019 (TTI Urban Mobility Report)
estimable_from: probe-vehicle speeds or a traffic assignment model

name: Gross domestic product
definition: GDP = Σ gross value added + taxes − subsidies on products
estimable_from: downscaling by workplace employment × sector productivity, or night-lights regression

name: Gross value added
definition: GVA = output − intermediate consumption
estimable_from: regional GVA allocated by workplace employment and sector wages

name: Gross national income
definition: GNI = GDP + net primary income from abroad
estimable_from: household income surveys scaled to national accounts

name: Labour productivity growth
definition: Δ ln(GVA / hours worked)

name: Total factor productivity
definition: Solow residual: ln A = ln Y − α ln K − (1−α) ln L
estimable_from: growth accounting, or production-function estimation (Olley–Pakes) on firm data
law: A grows exogenously (Solow 1957) or with R&D and knowledge spillovers (Romer 1990)
sections: 01 Macroeconomics and Business Cycles; 15 Business Demography and Local Entrepreneurship

name: Inflation rate
definition: π = ln(CPI_t / CPI_t−12) on monthly data
source: ILO, IMF et al. 2020 CPI Manual
estimable_from: regional price indices from scanner or web prices

name: Consumer price index
definition: Lowe/Laspeyres index Σ w_i p_it / p_i0 with household expenditure weights
source: ILO, IMF et al. 2020 CPI Manual

name: Interest rate
definition: Nominal annual rate on a reference instrument (policy rate, mortgage rate or bond yield)
estimable_from: observed nationally; a future path must be declared as a scenario

name: Nominal exchange rate
definition: Units of domestic currency per unit of foreign currency
estimable_from: observed; a future path must be declared

name: Real exchange rate
definition: RER = e · P* / P
estimable_from: from nominal rates and price indices

name: Output gap
definition: (Y − Y*) / Y*, potential output Y* by filter or production function
estimable_from: HP filter or production-function potential on GDP series
notes: alt: dated recessions (NBER) as a binary indicator

name: Unemployment rate
definition: U / (E + U); unemployed = without work, available and seeking (ILO)
estimable_from: small-area model (Fay–Herriot) on labour force survey + claimant counts
law: u' = s(1 − u) − f·u: separations and job finding (Shimer 2012)
sections: 01 Macroeconomics and Business Cycles; 21 Labor Markets and Urban Employment

name: Time-related underemployment rate
definition: Share of employed working below an hours threshold who want and are available for more hours
estimable_from: small-area model on labour force survey
law: moves with unemployment over the cycle (Okun 1962)

name: Wage growth rate
definition: Δ ln median hourly earnings, year on year
law: wage curve: growth falls with local unemployment (Phillips 1958; Blanchflower & Oswald 1994)

name: Real disposable household income per capita
definition: (income − taxes + transfers) / CPI, per person
source: OECD 2013 Framework for Statistics on Household Income; UN SNA 2008
estimable_from: small-area model on survey incomes + census covariates

name: Household debt
definition: Outstanding liabilities of households: mortgages and consumer credit
law: D' = new borrowing − repayments; borrowing rises with house prices (Mian & Sufi 2011)
notes: often reported as ratio to disposable income

name: Household final consumption expenditure
definition: Household spending on goods and services (SNA P.31)
estimable_from: card-transaction data scaled to survey totals
law: C = c0 + c1·Y_d (Keynes 1936) or permanent income (Friedman 1957)

name: Gross fixed capital formation
definition: Acquisitions less disposals of fixed assets (SNA P.51g)
estimable_from: building permits and construction output by area
law: K' = I − δK (perpetual inventory; OECD 2009)

name: Current account balance
definition: Exports − imports of goods and services + net primary and secondary income

name: Public debt
definition: Gross debt of general government or a municipality (GFS liabilities)
estimable_from: observed in accounts; declared for scenarios
law: B' = spending − revenue + r·B (government budget constraint)

name: Purchasing power parity
definition: Conversion rate equalising the cost of a common basket across countries (ICP)
estimable_from: subnational price levels from rents and wages

name: Sectoral employment share
definition: Share of employment in agriculture, industry and services
law: reallocation from agriculture to industry to services as income grows (Herrendorf et al. 2014)
sections: 01 Macroeconomics and Business Cycles; 02 Labor and Local Business Ecosystems

name: Regional resistance index
definition: (ΔE_r/E_r − ΔE_n/E_n) / |ΔE_n/E_n| over a recession
estimable_from: from regional and national employment series
sections: 01 Macroeconomics and Business Cycles; 02 Tourism and Visitor Economy
notes: alt: recovery index (same form, upturn); applied to arrivals or tourism employment

name: Deadweight loss
definition: Harberger triangle: DWL ≈ ½ ε (t/p)² p q
estimable_from: from elasticities and the tax or price wedge

name: Distributional (welfare) weight
definition: w_i = (ȳ / y_i)^e, e = elasticity of marginal utility of income
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 09 Policy Appraisal and Decision Theory
keywords: Distributional weights; Distributional weights; Distributional trade-offs

name: Social marginal cost
definition: SMC = private marginal cost + marginal external cost

name: Social marginal benefit
definition: SMB = private marginal benefit + marginal external benefit

name: Public investment
definition: Government gross fixed capital formation (GFS)
law: K_g' = I_g − δK_g (perpetual inventory)

name: Benefit incidence share
definition: Share of public spending benefits by income quintile: unit cost × use by quintile
estimable_from: service use from surveys × unit costs
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Tax pass-through rate
definition: Share of a tax borne by buyers: ε_s / (ε_s − ε_d)
estimable_from: price response to tax changes, or estimated elasticities

name: Kakwani progressivity index
definition: K = C_T − G_X: concentration index of taxes minus Gini of pre-tax income
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers
keywords: Progressive taxation; Regressive taxation; Fiscal burden shifting; Vertical inequity
notes: K < 0 is regressive; positive is progressive; for property tax assessment see price-related differential (IAAO)

name: Subsidy expenditure
definition: Government payments to producers or consumers that lower prices (GFS 25)

name: User charge revenue
definition: Revenue from fees paid by users of a public service
law: revenue = tariff × use; use falls with tariff by its price elasticity
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 07 Municipal Finance and Urban Investment

name: Public expenditure
definition: Total government expense + net acquisition of nonfinancial assets (GFS)
law: spending bounded by revenue and debt rules (government budget constraint)

name: Service coverage rate
definition: Share of population served by a public service to a standard (water, sanitation, waste collection, schools)
estimable_from: service areas overlaid on gridded population
law: coverage rises with network extension investment
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Development Economics; 07 Municipal Governance and Public Administration; 08 GIS and Spatial Data Infrastructure; 14 Transport Infrastructure Resilience
keywords: Public service provision; Service delivery; Public service delivery; Service area analysis; Access to essential services; Evacuation accessibility
notes: threshold (400 m, 15 min) and mode declared; essential services; shelters within reach

name: Social return on investment
definition: SROI = PV of monetised social outcomes (net of deadweight, attribution, drop-off) / PV of inputs

name: Willingness to pay
definition: Maximum payment a person would make for a good or change (Hicksian compensating variation for a gain)
estimable_from: stated preference (CV, choice experiment), hedonic or travel-cost model, benefit transfer
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 01 Behavioral and Experimental Economics; 02 Demand Analysis; 06 Environmental Economics and Sustainability; 09 Market Research and Choice Modeling; 15 Pricing, Markups, and Profitability; 26 Policy Alternatives and Option Appraisal
keywords: Willingness to pay; Willingness to pay; Discrete choice experiments; Reservation price; Consumer willingness to pay; Contingent valuation; Choice modeling; Willingness-to-pay estimation; Reservation prices; Nonmarket valuation; Choice experiments for policy
notes: the method's result (with part-worths); a buyer's maximum price; the method's result; the buyer's reservation price; marginal WTP per attribute

name: Willingness to accept
definition: Minimum compensation accepted to forgo a good or bear a loss
estimable_from: stated preference; benefit transfer with a WTA/WTP ratio
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money
keywords: Willingness to accept; Willingness to accept

name: Shadow price (conversion factor)
definition: Accounting price reflecting social opportunity cost; conversion factor = shadow / market price
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 09 Policy Appraisal and Decision Theory

name: Net benefit by income group
definition: Net benefit or change in disposable income by income decile, also as share of income
estimable_from: microsimulation joining project impacts to survey households
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 03 Spatial Inequality and Neighborhood Change
keywords: Distributional impact; Distributional impact; Distributional incidence

name: Social discount rate
definition: Ramsey rule: r = δ + η·g
sections: 01 Welfare and Public Economics; 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 12 Equity, Distribution, and Urban Justice; 26 Primary and Secondary Urban Constraints
keywords: Social discount rate; Social discount rate; Intergenerational justice; Intertemporal trade-offs

name: Net benefit
definition: NB = B − C, undiscounted, for a period or in total
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Gross benefit
definition: Total benefits before deducting any costs
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Gross cost
definition: Total capital, operating and maintenance costs before offsetting revenues
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Net social benefit
definition: Social benefits − social costs to all members of society, externalities included
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Net private benefit
definition: Private benefits − private costs to an investor or household, at market prices
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Net economic benefit
definition: Benefits − costs at shadow (economic) prices, transfers excluded
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Net fiscal benefit
definition: Change in public revenues − change in public expenditure caused by a project or development
estimable_from: fiscal impact model: per-capita or case-study multipliers
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money
keywords: Net fiscal benefit; Fiscal impact assessment

name: Net community benefit
definition: Net social benefit counted for residents of one jurisdiction only (restricted standing)
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Net welfare change
definition: ΔW = Σ_i w_i·CV_i: aggregate (possibly weighted) compensating variations; > 0 gain, < 0 loss
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money
keywords: Net welfare gain; Net welfare loss

name: Incremental net benefit
definition: NB(with project) − NB(without project), per year or discounted
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money
keywords: Incremental net benefit; Counterfactual net benefit

name: Marginal net benefit
definition: dNB/dq = marginal benefit − marginal cost of one more unit of scale
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Expected net benefit
definition: E[NB] = Σ_s p_s·NB_s over states or scenarios
estimable_from: Monte Carlo over declared input distributions
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Net present value
definition: NPV = Σ_t (B_t − C_t) / (1 + r)^t
source: Boardman et al. 2018; HM Treasury 2022 Green Book
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money
keywords: Discounted net benefit; Net present value; Discounted cash flow

name: Economic net present value
definition: ENPV: NPV of economic flows at shadow prices and the social discount rate
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Financial net present value
definition: FNPV: NPV of the investor's cash flows at market prices and a financial discount rate
estimable_from: cash-flow model on declared tariffs and costs
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 07 Municipal Finance and Urban Investment; 16 Development Feasibility and Real-Estate Cycles
keywords: Financial net present value; Financial viability; Net present value of development

name: Social net present value
definition: NPV of all social costs and benefits, nonmarket and external included, at the social discount rate
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money
keywords: Social net present value; Net present social value

name: Benefit–cost ratio
definition: BCR = PV(B) / PV(C)
source: HM Treasury 2022 Green Book; DfT TAG Unit A1.1
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 09 Program Monitoring and Impact Evaluation; 14 Infrastructure Finance and Resilience Investment; 26 Policy Alternatives and Option Appraisal
keywords: Benefit–cost ratio; Value for money; Benefit-cost ratio of resilience; Multihazard cost–benefit analysis; Benefit–cost assessment
notes: alt: VfM rubric of economy, efficiency, effectiveness, equity (DFID 2011)

name: Net benefit–cost ratio
definition: NBCR = NPV / PV(investment or public cost)
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Economic internal rate of return
definition: EIRR: discount rate at which ENPV = 0
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Financial internal rate of return
definition: FIRR: discount rate at which FNPV = 0
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Social rate of return
definition: Discount rate at which the social NPV = 0 (all social costs and benefits)
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Internal rate of return
definition: IRR: r solving Σ_t (B_t − C_t) / (1 + r)^t = 0
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Modified internal rate of return
definition: MIRR = (FV of inflows at reinvestment rate / PV of outflows at finance rate)^(1/n) − 1
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Discount factor
definition: DF_t = 1 / (1 + r)^t, or a declining schedule
estimable_from: cannot: follows from the declared rate
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Present value of benefits
definition: PVB = Σ_t B_t / (1 + r)^t
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Present value of costs
definition: PVC = Σ_t C_t / (1 + r)^t
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Net cash flow
definition: Cash inflows − cash outflows in a period
estimable_from: cash-flow model on declared tariffs and costs
law: cumulative cash C' = inflows − outflows
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Life-cycle cost
definition: LCC = PV of acquisition, operation, maintenance and disposal costs over the service life
estimable_from: cost model on unit rates and service lives
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 07 Municipal Finance and Urban Investment

name: Whole-life cost
definition: WLC = LCC + non-construction costs, income and externalities over the life
estimable_from: cost model on unit rates and service lives
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money; 14 Infrastructure Asset Management and Maintenance

name: Life-cycle benefit
definition: PV of all benefits over an asset's service life
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Total economic value
definition: TEV = direct use + indirect use + option + non-use (existence, bequest) values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Economic surplus
definition: CS + PS (+ government revenue)
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Change in consumer surplus
definition: Rule of a half: ΔCS ≈ ½ (q0 + q1)(g0 − g1), g = generalised cost
estimable_from: transport or demand model with generalised costs
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Change in producer surplus
definition: Δ(revenue − operating cost) to operators and producers
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Compensating variation
definition: CV = e(p1, u0) − e(p0, u0): payment that restores initial utility after a change

name: Equivalent variation
definition: EV = e(p0, u1) − e(p0, u0): payment equivalent to the change at initial prices
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Sunk cost
definition: Cost already incurred and unrecoverable; excluded from forward-looking appraisal
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Avoided cost
definition: Costs not incurred because of the project, relative to the counterfactual
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Avoided damage (expected annual)
definition: EAD_without − EAD_with, EAD = ∫ D(p) dp over annual exceedance probability
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Avoided loss (expected annual)
definition: Reduction in expected annual loss, direct + indirect (business interruption), due to mitigation
estimable_from: catastrophe model + input–output or CGE for indirect loss
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Avoided maintenance cost
definition: Maintenance outlays not required with the project

sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Replacement cost
definition: Cost of replacing an asset or service with an equivalent at current prices
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Residual value
definition: Value of assets at the end of the appraisal period (remaining life or market value)
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Salvage value
definition: Net proceeds from disposal of an asset at the end of its life
estimable_from: cost–benefit model on declared costs, benefits and unit values
sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Indirect benefit
definition: Benefits in secondary markets, counted only where prices diverge from social cost

sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Induced benefit
definition: Benefits to newly generated users or activity (induced demand)

name: Spillover benefit
definition: Benefits accruing outside the target group or area (agglomeration, knowledge spillovers)

name: External benefit
definition: Unpriced benefits to third parties: Σ impacts × unit values

sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money

name: Nonmarket benefit
definition: Benefits without a market price (amenity, health, environment), monetised by revealed or stated preference

name: Equity-weighted net present value

sections: 01 Net Benefits, Economic Appraisal, and Value for Money
keywords: Distributional cost–benefit analysis; Equity-adjusted net benefits

name: Cost incidence share
definition: Share of project or tax costs borne by each income group or stakeholder

name: Net benefit by stakeholder group

name: Net fiscal incidence
definition: Benefits from public spending minus taxes paid, by income decile

name: Incremental cost

definition: Difference in uptake share between opt-out and opt-in defaults

name: Degree centrality
sections: 08 Network Science and Urban Complexity; 13 Power, Voice, and Political Representation
notes: alt: betweenness or closeness centrality; subject: policy actor networks

name: Betweenness centrality
definition: C_B(v) = Σ_{s≠v≠t} σ_st(v)/σ_st
notes: for streets often angular choice (Hillier & Iida 2005)

name: Closeness centrality
definition: C_C(i) = (N − 1)/Σ_j d_ij

name: Degree distribution exponent
definition: γ in P(k) ∝ k^−γ, fitted by maximum likelihood with a lower cutoff
notes: street networks are rarely scale-free; report the distribution

name: Community membership
definition: Partition of nodes maximising modularity (Louvain) or minimising the map equation (Infomap)

name: Network modularity
definition: Q = (1/2m) Σ_ij [A_ij − k_i k_j/2m] δ(c_i, c_j)

name: Global network efficiency
definition: E = Σ_{i≠j} (1/d_ij) / (N(N−1)); resilience read as E after disruption / E before

name: Percolation threshold
definition: Critical fraction of nodes or edges removed at which the giant component vanishes

name: Cascade size
definition: Share of nodes failed after an initial failure under load redistribution
sections: 08 Network Science and Urban Complexity; 14 Hazards, Exposure, Vulnerability, and Cascading Failure; 14 Critical Infrastructure Interdependencies
keywords: Cascading effects; Cascading failure; Cascading risk; Systemic risk propagation; Interdependent network failure

name: Origin–destination flow
definition: T_ij trips from i to j per period
estimable_from: doubly constrained gravity model; mobile phone data
law: T_ij = A_i O_i B_j D_j exp(−β c_ij), entropy-maximising (Wilson 1971)
sections: 08 Network Science and Urban Complexity; 15 Tourism Demand and Destination Markets
keywords: Spatial interaction networks; Origin–destination tourism flows

name: Robustness index
definition: R = (1/N) Σ_Q s(Q), s the giant-component share after removing Q nodes in targeted order

name: Node criticality (importance)
definition: Drop in network performance (efficiency or total travel cost) when the node or link is removed
sections: 08 Network Science and Urban Complexity; 14 Transport Infrastructure Resilience
keywords: Critical nodes; Corridor vulnerability; Critical bridge identification; Network criticality

name: Sobol' sensitivity index
definition: S_i = Var(E[Y|X_i]) / Var(Y), first-order share of output variance due to input i
notes: alt: Morris elementary effects for screening

name: Root mean squared error
definition: RMSE = √(Σ (ŷ_i − y_i)²/n) on data not used for fitting

name: Population stability index
definition: PSI = Σ_b (a_b − e_b) ln(a_b/e_b) over bins of a variable, current share a vs reference e
estimable_from: computed on current and reference data
sections: 08 Machine Learning for Urban Analysis; 28 AI, Forecasting, and Decision Support
keywords: Distribution shift; Data drift; Concept drift
notes: alt: Kullback–Leibler divergence; PSI > 0.25 read as a major shift

name: Equalized odds difference
definition: max over groups of |TPR_a − TPR_b| and |FPR_a − FPR_b|
estimable_from: computed on labelled outcomes by group

name: Data completeness rate
definition: Share of required records or values present (1 − omission rate)

name: Reliability ratio
definition: λ = Var(true) / Var(observed); attenuates OLS slopes by λ

name: Item nonresponse rate
definition: Share of eligible items left unanswered or missing

name: Disparate impact ratio
definition: DI = P(ŷ=1 | unprivileged) / P(ŷ=1 | privileged); below 0.8 fails the four-fifths rule
sections: 08 Data Quality, Ethics, and Governance; 25 Measurement Quality and Responsible Data Use

name: Open data index (OURdata)
definition: Weighted score of data availability, accessibility and government support for reuse
sections: 08 Data Quality, Ethics, and Governance; 12 Innovation and Future Urban Systems; 25 Urban Data Sources and Data Linkage; 28 Digital Public Infrastructure and Inclusion
keywords: Open data; Open urban data; Municipal open data; Open government platforms
notes: alt: Global Open Data Index (Open Knowledge Foundation)

name: k-anonymity level
definition: Smallest number k of records sharing any combination of quasi-identifiers in a release

name: Service coverage gap
definition: Share of the population in need not receiving the service: 1 − coverage
estimable_from: small-area model on survey and service records

name: Self-reported unmet need rate
definition: Share of persons reporting a need for a service they did not receive, by reason
estimable_from: small-area model (Fay–Herriot) on survey and census covariates
sections: 09 Needs Assessment and Problem Diagnosis; 26 Urban Needs Identification

name: Community priority rank
definition: Rank of issues from participatory pairwise or matrix ranking, or from a ranked-choice survey

name: Capacity gap score
definition: Difference between the desired and the assessed level on each capacity of a rubric

name: Concentration index
definition: C = 2 cov(y_i, R_i) / ȳ, R the fractional rank by socioeconomic status
estimable_from: computed on unit data with a rank variable
sections: 09 Needs Assessment and Problem Diagnosis; 12 Equity, Distribution, and Urban Justice; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers
keywords: Distributional exposure; Unequal exposure; Inequitable burden
notes: negative when exposure falls on the poor; subject: hazard exposure by income rank; subject: burdens by income rank

name: Problem severity score
definition: Phased severity classes from indicators of conditions and needs (1 minimal to 5 catastrophic)
estimable_from: cannot: must be assessed by panel
sections: 09 Needs Assessment and Problem Diagnosis; 14 Disaster Response, Recovery, and Reconstruction

name: Affected population
definition: Persons requiring immediate assistance or otherwise affected by an event or problem
estimable_from: overlay of hazard footprint on gridded population

name: Hoover concentration index
definition: H = ½ Σ_i |p_i/P − a_i/A|, share of a quantity that would have to move to match area shares
sections: 09 Needs Assessment and Problem Diagnosis; 11 International Visitors and Heterogeneous Urban Demand; 21 Population and Demographic Change
keywords: Spatial concentration; Visitor dispersal; Population concentration
notes: alt: spatial Gini; of visitors across zones

name: Temporal concentration (Gini over periods)
definition: Gini coefficient of a quantity across periods (hours, months)

name: E-value
definition: E = RR + √(RR(RR − 1)): least strength of confounding that would explain away an observed risk ratio RR
sections: 09 Research Design and Causal Inference; 25 Spatial Econometrics and Causal Methods
keywords: Sensitivity to unobservables; Sensitivity to unobserved confounding

name: Conditional average treatment effect
estimable_from: causal forests or meta-learners on experimental or quasi-experimental data

name: Statistical power
definition: 1 − β: probability of rejecting H0 when the effect of a declared size is present
estimable_from: computed from design, sample size and effect size
notes: design index; alt: minimum detectable effect

name: Standardised effect size (Cohen's d)
definition: d = (ȳ_T − ȳ_C) / s_pooled
estimable_from: computed from group means and SDs
notes: alt: Hedges' g for small samples

name: Moran's I
definition: I = (N/W) Σ_ij w_ij (x_i − x̄)(x_j − x̄) / Σ_i (x_i − x̄)²
estimable_from: computed on area data with a declared weights matrix
sections: 09 Statistics and Spatial Econometrics; 25 Spatial Econometrics and Causal Methods
keywords: Spatial autocorrelation; Moran's I; Spatial autocorrelation diagnostics

name: Kernel density surface
definition: f(s) = Σ_i (1/h²) K(‖s − s_i‖/h): smoothed intensity of points
estimable_from: computed from point locations with a declared bandwidth

name: Response rate
definition: RR1 = complete interviews / (eligible + unknown eligibility cases)
notes: low response rate does not imply bias; see r_indicator

name: Hedonic implicit price
definition: ∂P/∂z_k from a regression of price on attributes, P = f(z_1 … z_K)
estimable_from: hedonic regression on sales or listings
sections: 09 Market Research and Choice Modeling; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers; 15 Pricing, Markups, and Profitability
keywords: Hedonic models; Amenity capitalization; Hedonic prices

name: Product–market fit score
definition: Share of active users who would be very disappointed without the product; 40% read as fit
notes: alt: flattening of the retention curve

name: Measurement invariance level
unit: levels: none, configural, metric, scalar, strict
definition: Highest level of equality of a measurement model across groups not rejected (e.g. ΔCFI ≤ 0.01)

name: Index of consumer sentiment
definition: Relative score of five questions on finances and business conditions, ICS = Σ relative scores/6.7558 + 2.0
source: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers (Katona 1951)
estimable_from: cannot: must be surveyed; nowcast from search trends

name: Average treatment effect
definition: ATE = E[Y(1) − Y(0)], estimated by an identified design

name: Implementation fidelity index
definition: Share of core components delivered as designed, with dose and coverage (adherence)
estimable_from: cannot: must be observed or audited
sections: 09 Program Monitoring and Impact Evaluation; 26 Evidence Grading and Decision Relevance; 26 Learning, Transferability, and Scale-Up
keywords: Implementation fidelity; Implementation evaluation; Adaptation fidelity

name: Cost per QALY gained
definition: Incremental cost / incremental quality-adjusted life years
estimable_from: computed from costs and utility-weighted outcomes

name: Sustainability rating (DAC)
definition: Rated likelihood that net benefits continue after support ends (highly likely … unlikely)
source: OECD DAC 2019 criteria; World Bank IEG
sections: 09 Program Monitoring and Impact Evaluation; 10 Cross-Country Policy Transfer

name: MCDA weighted score
definition: V(a) = Σ_k w_k v_k(a), normalised value functions with declared weights

name: Maximum regret
definition: max_s [max_a' V(a', s) − V(a, s)] over scenarios s

name: Real option value
definition: Value of the right to defer, expand or abandon, by contingent claims or dynamic programming
estimable_from: binomial lattice or Monte Carlo on project value
sections: 09 Policy Appraisal and Decision Theory; 25 Urban Simulation and Computational Modeling; 26 Policy Alternatives and Option Appraisal
keywords: Real options; Real-options simulation; Real options analysis

name: Expected value of perfect information
definition: EVPI = E_θ[max_a U(a, θ)] − max_a E_θ[U(a, θ)]

name: Expected value of sample information
definition: EVSI = E_x[max_a E_θ|x U(a, θ)] − max_a E_θ U(a, θ)
estimable_from: preposterior analysis of the decision model

name: Expected utility
definition: EU(a) = Σ_s p(s) u(x(a, s))
estimable_from: computed from probabilities and a declared utility function

name: Institutional feasibility rating
definition: Rubric on mandate, capacity, coordination and resources needed to implement an option
sections: 09 Policy Appraisal and Decision Theory; 10 Cross-Country Policy Transfer

name: Political feasibility rating
definition: Stakeholders' position × power × salience mapped to support for an option (PolicyMaker)
sections: 09 Policy Appraisal and Decision Theory; 26 Policy Alternatives and Option Appraisal

name: Adaptation tipping point
unit: units of the driver (e.g. m of sea-level rise)
definition: Magnitude of a driver at which a strategy no longer meets its objectives
source: Kwadijk et al. 2010; Haasnoot et al. 2013
notes: a trigger is set before it, allowing lead time

name: Pooled effect size
definition: μ̂ = Σ w_i y_i / Σ w_i, w_i = 1/(v_i + τ²) (random effects)

name: I² heterogeneity
definition: I² = (Q − df)/Q, share of variation across studies due to heterogeneity

name: Certainty of evidence (GRADE)
unit: levels: high, moderate, low, very low
definition: Start high (RCTs) or low (observational); down for risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision, publication bias

name: Economic internal rate of return
definition: EIRR: discount rate r at which Σ_t (B_t − C_t)/(1 + r)^t = 0, economic prices

name: Budget execution rate
definition: Actual expenditure / approved budget in the period (aggregate and by composition)
sections: 10 Project Preparation and Delivery; 19 Public Expenditure and Fiscal Incidence

name: Implementation progress rating (ISR)
unit: 6 levels: HS, S, MS, MU, U, HU
definition: Supervision rating of progress toward the development objective and of implementation
estimable_from: cannot: rated by the task team
sections: 10 Project Preparation and Delivery; 27 Development Project Cycle
keywords: Project supervision; Implementation status and results report

name: City Resilience Index
definition: Qualitative and quantitative ratings on 4 dimensions, 12 goals, 52 indicators, aggregated to goal profiles
law: resilience capacity builds with investment and erodes with neglect
notes: alt: UNDRR Disaster Resilience Scorecard for Cities

name: Growth rate of GDP per capita
definition: g = ln(y_t / y_t−1), y real GDP per capita
source: World Bank 2015 (Competitive Cities for Jobs and Growth)
estimable_from: regional accounts downscaled by night lights or employment
notes: World Bank reads competitive cities as the top decile in this growth, with jobs and income growth

name: Global Liveability Index
definition: Weighted ratings of 30 factors in stability, healthcare, culture and environment, education and infrastructure

name: Access to basic services
definition: Share of population in households with access to basic water, sanitation, energy, waste collection and mobility
estimable_from: small-area model on census and surveys
law: access rises with network extension and connections
sections: 10 World Bank Urban Development Vocabulary; 16 Informality and Incremental Urban Development; 25 Urban Indicators and Composite Indices
keywords: Municipal services; Basic service deficits; Urban service coverage

name: Quality of land administration index
definition: Sum of scores on reliability of infrastructure, transparency, coverage, dispute resolution and equal access
sections: 10 World Bank Urban Development Vocabulary; 16 Land Value, Tenure, and Land Administration; 28 Digital Public Infrastructure and Inclusion
keywords: Land administration; Land administration systems; Digital land records

name: Urban Governance Index
definition: Mean of sub-indexes of effectiveness, equity, participation and accountability, from 25 indicators

name: Normalized learning gain
definition: g = (post − pre) / (max − pre) on a test of the learning objectives
estimable_from: cannot: needs pre and post tests
sections: 10 Technical Deep Dives and Practitioner Learning

name: Training evaluation level (Kirkpatrick)
definition: Highest Kirkpatrick level at which an effect of training is shown
sections: 10 Technical Deep Dives and Practitioner Learning

name: Knowledge application rate
definition: Share of participants who applied the learning in their work within a stated period (Kirkpatrick level 3)
sections: 10 Technical Deep Dives and Practitioner Learning

name: Fiscal capacity per capita
definition: Revenue a jurisdiction would raise at standard (national average) rates on its bases, per person
estimable_from: representative tax system on tax bases
sections: 10 Cross-Country Policy Transfer; 19 Municipal Revenue and Fiscal Capacity; 25 Urban Indicators and Composite Indices
keywords: Fiscal capacity; Fiscal capacity equalization; Local fiscal capacity index

name: Perceived legitimacy
definition: Latent score from items on obligation to obey, trust and normative alignment with an authority or reform
estimable_from: IRT or factor model from survey items
law: legitimacy erodes with perceived unfairness (procedural justice; Tyler 1990)
sections: 10 Cross-Country Policy Transfer; 11 Ginza Governance, Heritage, and Urban Change; 13 Institutional Change and Path Dependence; 20 Trust, Credibility, and Knowledge Mediation; 20 Participation, Deliberation, and Co-Production; 21 Street Vendors, Informal Markets, and Public Livelihoods; 30 Ginza Urban Needs and Competing Priorities
keywords: Stakeholder legitimacy; Design legitimacy; Institutional legitimacy deficit; Social legitimacy; Engagement legitimacy; Street trade legitimacy; Ginza public-space legitimacy
notes: subject: design rules; input legitimacy of the process; public acceptance of street trade; of public-space management

name: Stakeholder salience class
definition: Class from the presence of power, legitimacy and urgency: dormant … definitive
law: salience shifts as attributes are gained or lost

name: Environmental and social risk classification
definition: Class from the nature and scale of potential impacts, context and capacity

name: Public participation level (IAP2)
unit: levels 1–5: inform, consult, involve, collaborate, empower
definition: Point on the IAP2 spectrum reached by an engagement process

name: Project-displaced persons
definition: Persons physically or economically displaced by land acquisition or restriction of use
estimable_from: census of affected assets and households
sections: 10 Safeguards, Inclusion, and Implementation Risks; 27 Project Risks, Safeguards, and Accountability
keywords: Resettlement; Involuntary displacement; Land acquisition risk

name: Livelihood restoration ratio
definition: Income or living standard of displaced households after resettlement / before (target ≥ 1)

name: Lost-time injury frequency rate
definition: LTIFR = lost-time injuries × 10^6 / hours worked

name: Gender Inequality Index
definition: Geometric-mean composite of reproductive health, empowerment and labour-market gaps between women and men
notes: at project level: women's share of beneficiaries

name: Share of facilities meeting accessibility standards
definition: Share of public buildings, stations or routes compliant with a universal-access standard
estimable_from: audit of a sample of facilities
law: rises with retrofits and new compliant building
sections: 10 Safeguards, Inclusion, and Implementation Risks; 11 Ginza Street Research Methods

name: Compliance rate
definition: Share of commitments or requirements found in compliance at inspection
sections: 10 Safeguards, Inclusion, and Implementation Risks; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers

name: Multilingual information coverage
definition: Share of signs and information points giving content in the declared languages
estimable_from: audit of a sample of points
law: grows with sign replacement programmes
sections: 11 International Visitors and Heterogeneous Urban Demand

name: Visitor segment
definition: Segment from cluster or latent class analysis of origin, motivation, spending and behaviour
estimable_from: latent class analysis of intercept surveys
sections: 11 International Visitors and Heterogeneous Urban Demand; 15 Tourism Demand and Destination Markets

name: Wayfinding success rate
definition: Share of navigation tasks reaching the destination without error within a time limit
sections: 11 International Visitors and Heterogeneous Urban Demand

name: Repeat visitation rate
definition: Share of visitors who have visited the destination before
estimable_from: cannot: survey or loyalty data needed
sections: 11 International Visitors and Heterogeneous Urban Demand

name: Imageability score
definition: Score from counted street features (landmarks, historic buildings, outdoor dining, courtyards) weighted as fitted to expert ratings
estimable_from: models on street-view imagery (Naik et al. 2014)
sections: 11 International Visitors and Heterogeneous Urban Demand
notes: Lynch's legibility has no single measure

name: Independent store share
definition: Share of occupied retail units not part of a multiple (chain) of ten or more outlets
sections: 11 Ginza Commercial Ecology; 15 Retail Economics and Commercial Street Dynamics
notes: chain threshold declared; inverse of homogenisation; alt NEF Clone Town score

name: Commercial rent growth rate
definition: Annual change in achieved rent per m² of retail floor space
law: rent adjusts to vacancy relative to its natural rate (Wheaton & Torto 1988)

name: Occupancy cost ratio
definition: (Rent + service charges) / tenant sales
sections: 11 Ginza Commercial Ecology; 15 Retail Economics and Commercial Street Dynamics; 30 Ginza Urban Needs and Competing Priorities
keywords: Commercial rent pressure; Retail rental burden; Retail occupancy cost; Ginza retail affordability

name: Retail category diversity (Shannon)
definition: H = −Σ_k p_k ln p_k over tenant categories

name: Active frontage ratio
definition: Share of ground-floor street frontage with active, open uses
sections: 11 Ginza Commercial Ecology; 15 Retail Economics and Commercial Street Dynamics; 17 Public-Space Use and Street Activity; 30 Ginza Public Space, Street Operations, and Accessibility
keywords: Storefront continuity; Retail frontage activation; Street-facing commerce; Walkable frontage; Ginza storefront activity

name: Night-time economy share
definition: Share of businesses (or jobs) in activities operating between 18:00 and 06:00

name: Population with access to public open space
definition: Share of population within 400 m walk of public open space; with open space as share of built-up area

name: Public seating density
definition: Public seats per 100 m of street (or linear metres per 100 m² of plaza)
sections: 11 Pedestrian Street and Public-Space Management; 17 Public-Space Use and Street Activity; 21 Care, Education, and Social Infrastructure; 30 Ginza Urban Needs and Competing Priorities
keywords: Street seating; Rest opportunities; Resting opportunities; Public rest spaces; Ginza resting-space availability

name: Perceived walkability (NEWS)
definition: Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale: density, mix, access, connectivity, infrastructure, aesthetics, safety subscales
estimable_from: IRT or factor model from survey items

name: User group share
definition: Share of observed people in a declared group (gender, age, visitor or resident)

name: Permit processing time
definition: Calendar days from a complete application to a decision on a planning or building permit
sections: 11 Ginza Governance, Heritage, and Urban Change

name: Building replacement rate
definition: Buildings demolished and rebuilt per year / building stock
estimable_from: stock-flow identity from completions and demolitions
law: survival model of building lifetimes (Kohler & Hassler 2002)
sections: 11 Ginza Governance, Heritage, and Urban Change

name: Public-space activity type
definition: Class of an observed stationary activity in a declared typology

name: Ground-floor transparency
definition: Proportion of the ground-floor street wall that is windows

name: Green View Index
definition: Share of vegetation pixels in street-level images sampled at points in several directions

name: Old-age dependency ratio
definition: OADR = persons aged 65+ / persons aged 15–64 × 100
sections: 12 Demography and Social Transformation; 21 Population and Demographic Change

name: Total fertility rate
definition: TFR = Σ_a f_a × 5, the sum of age-specific fertility rates (5-year groups)
estimable_from: small-area model from births and census; own-children method
law: fertility transition; tempo-adjusted TFR (Bongaarts & Feeney 1998)
sections: 12 Demography and Social Transformation; 21 Population and Demographic Change

name: Net migration rate
definition: (in-migrants − out-migrants) / mid-year population × 1000
estimable_from: residual of the balancing equation; gravity model of flows
law: P' = B − D + I − O; flows respond to wage and amenity gaps (Harris & Todaro 1970; Roback 1982)

name: International migrant stock share
definition: Foreign-born (or foreign citizen) residents / total population
estimable_from: small-area model from census and registers
law: stock' = arrivals − departures − deaths − naturalisation

name: Headship rate
definition: Household reference persons / persons, by age (and sex)
estimable_from: projected from census trends by age
law: households = Σ_a headship_a × population_a

name: Average household size
definition: Persons in private households / private households

name: Time spent on unpaid care work
definition: Mean minutes per day in unpaid domestic and care work, by sex

name: Youth NEET rate
definition: Share of persons aged 15–24 not in employment, education or training
estimable_from: small-area model on labour force survey and census

name: Migrant–native employment rate gap
definition: Employment rate of natives − employment rate of foreign-born (15–64)
source: OECD/EU Indicators of Immigrant Integration 2018 (Zaragoza indicators)
estimable_from: small-area model on labour force survey
sections: 12 Demography and Social Transformation; 21 Labor Markets and Urban Employment

name: Ethnic fractionalization
definition: F = 1 − Σ_k s_k², probability two random residents belong to different groups

name: Household budget share
definition: Expenditure on a COICOP category / total household consumption expenditure
estimable_from: demand system (AIDS) on income and prices
law: shares move with income and prices (Deaton & Muellbauer 1980, AIDS)

name: Share of workdays worked from home
definition: Paid full days worked from home / all paid full workdays

name: Remote worker share
definition: Employed persons working mainly at home / employed persons

name: Time poverty rate
definition: Share of persons whose committed time (paid, unpaid, personal care) leaves less than a threshold of free time
notes: threshold declared (e.g. 60% of median free time)

name: Share of older people living in private households
definition: Persons aged 65+ (or 80+) living in private households / all persons of that age

name: Autonomous vehicle-km share
definition: Vehicle-km driven at SAE level 4–5 / all vehicle-km
estimable_from: scenario: cannot be estimated before deployment
law: adoption by diffusion (Bass 1969) in scenarios

name: Local Online Service Index
definition: Share of 60–80 indicators met on technology, content, services, participation of a city portal
sections: 12 Innovation and Future Urban Systems; 20 Municipal Institutional Capacity; 28 Digital Public Infrastructure and Inclusion
keywords: Digital public services; Public administration modernization; Urban digital public services

name: Perceived procedural fairness
definition: Latent score from items on voice, consistency, bias suppression, accuracy, correctability, ethicality
estimable_from: IRT or factor model from survey items
law: fair procedures raise legitimacy and compliance (Tyler 1990)
sections: 12 Equity, Distribution, and Urban Justice; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers

name: Accessibility poverty rate
definition: Share of persons whose accessibility falls below a declared sufficiency threshold
sections: 12 Equity, Distribution, and Urban Justice; 18 Transport Equity and Mobility Justice; 26 Urban Needs Identification
keywords: Accessibility justice; Transport justice; Accessibility gap analysis
notes: sufficientarian; alt: accessibility Gini; threshold must be declared

name: Disability employment gap
definition: Employment rate of persons without disability − with disability (Washington Group questions)
source: ONS; Washington Group on Disability Statistics
estimable_from: small-area model on labour force survey

name: Unsatisfied basic needs (NBI)
definition: Share of households with at least one unmet need: dwelling, overcrowding, water, sanitation, school attendance, dependency
notes: alt: SDG 1.4.1 access to basic services

name: Displacement risk typology
unit: classes (e.g. at risk of gentrification, ongoing displacement, advanced gentrification)
definition: Tract class from vulnerability, demographic change, housing market and investment indicators
law: neighbourhoods pass through stages of change (Hoover & Vernon 1959)
sections: 12 Equity, Distribution, and Urban Justice; 13 Property Rights, Land Politics, and Urban Coalitions; 16 Displacement, Gentrification, and Neighborhood Change
keywords: Displacement risk; Displacement pressure; Displacement early warning; Tenant displacement risk

name: Distributionally weighted net present value
definition: NPV_w = Σ_t Σ_i w_i (B_it − C_it) / (1 + r)^t, w_i distributional weights
sections: 12 Equity, Distribution, and Urban Justice; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers

name: Learning rate (experience curve)
definition: LR = 1 − 2^−b, b the elasticity of unit cost with cumulative output (C = C_0 Q^−b)
estimable_from: regression of unit cost on cumulative output

name: Incumbency advantage
definition: Causal effect of holding office on the next vote share, by regression discontinuity at close elections

name: Lobbying expenditure
definition: Disclosed spending on lobbying in the period; intensity as spending / revenue
sections: 13 Vested Interests and Political Incentives; 13 Property Rights, Land Politics, and Urban Coalitions

name: Reputational influence score
definition: Share of informed respondents who name an actor as influential on a policy domain

name: Clientelism index (V-Dem)
definition: Bayesian IRT aggregate of expert codes on vote buying, particularistic spending and party linkages
law: slow; persists with weak programmatic parties (Kitschelt & Wilkinson 2007)

name: Crony-capitalism index
definition: Billionaire wealth from rent-heavy sectors (casinos, land, resources, construction, utilities, banking) / GDP

name: Share of politically connected firms
definition: Share of firms (or market value) whose owners or directors are, or are close to, office holders
estimable_from: name matching of directors and officials

name: Share of losers from a reform
definition: Share of households whose disposable income (or welfare) falls under the reform beyond a threshold
sections: 13 Vested Interests and Political Incentives; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers

name: Share of winners from a reform
definition: Share of households whose disposable income (or welfare) rises under the reform beyond a threshold

name: Banzhaf power index
definition: Share of winning coalitions in which an actor is pivotal (normalised swings)
sections: 13 Vested Interests and Political Incentives; 13 Power, Voice, and Political Representation

name: Cabinet (coalition) duration
definition: Days a governing coalition stays in office, or relative duration (days / maximum term)
law: hazard of termination rises with fragmentation (Warwick 1994)

name: Number of veto players
definition: Count of individual or collective actors whose agreement is needed to change the status quo
sections: 13 Vested Interests and Political Incentives; 13 Public Choice and Political Decision Processes

name: Tenure in office
definition: Time from entry into office to exit, with the manner of exit
law: hazard of removal falls with winning-coalition size (Bueno de Mesquita et al. 2003)

name: Issue salience (most important problem)
definition: Share of respondents naming the issue as the most important problem facing the place
estimable_from: search trends and media attention as proxies
law: salience rises with events and decays (issue-attention cycle, Downs 1972)

name: Economic profit (rent above cost of capital)
definition: EP = (ROIC − WACC) × invested capital
sections: 13 Rent-Seeking, Capture, and Corruption; 15 Pricing, Markups, and Profitability

name: State capture index
definition: Share of firms reporting that sale of laws, decrees or rulings to private interests affects their business

name: Benefit leakage rate
definition: Share of programme benefits reaching households outside the target group (elite capture when to the top)
sections: 13 Rent-Seeking, Capture, and Corruption; 13 Distributional Conflict and Urban Winners and Losers

name: Corruption Risk Index (procurement)
definition: Mean of red flags per tender (single bid, short advertisement, non-open procedure, call changes, buyer concentration)

name: Bribery incidence
definition: Share of persons or firms who paid a bribe to a public official in the last 12 months

name: Kickback share of contract value
definition: Share of a government contract's value that firms report paying informally to secure it

name: Bid dispersion screen
definition: Coefficient of variation of bids in a tender; unusually low values flag possible collusion

name: Share of property held by anonymous companies
definition: Share of property titles held by companies in secrecy jurisdictions whose beneficial owners are undisclosed
estimable_from: matching land registry to company registers

name: External audit independence score (PEFA)
definition: Score on independence of the supreme audit institution from the executive (appointment, budget, access)

name: Meritocratic recruitment index

name: Climate vulnerability index
definition: Composite of exposure, sensitivity and adaptive capacity indicators

name: GHG emissions per capita
definition: Territorial (scope 1 + 2) GHG emissions / resident population

definition: Future emissions of existing infrastructure over its remaining expected lifetime

definition: Investment required per year to deliver declared mitigation and adaptation plans

definition: Annual gross carbon uptake by trees from allometric growth

name: Recreational visits to green space
definition: Visits to natural or green spaces per resident per year

law: travel-cost demand in distance and site quality (Clawson & Knetsch 1966)

name: Effective mesh size
definition: m_eff = (1/A_total) Σ_i A_i² over unfragmented patches

name: Native species share

definition: Share of green area with flowering resources and nesting habitat for pollinators

definition: Annual share of trees dying or removed (street trees about 3.5–5%)

name: Soil organic carbon
definition: Organic carbon content of topsoil (0–30 cm)
law: dC/dt = inputs − kC (RothC; Coleman & Jenkinson 1996)

name: Wetland area
definition: Area of wetlands (natural and restored)
law: area' = restoration − conversion

name: Riparian buffer coverage
definition: Share of stream length with ≥ 30 m vegetated buffer on both banks
law: share' = retrofit rate × (1 − share) − decay; asset stock by perpetual inventory (OECD 2009)

name: Invasive species cover
definition: Area covered by invasive alien species / surveyed area
law: spread by logistic growth with dispersal (Shigesada & Kawasaki 1997)

name: Habitat quality index (InVEST)
definition: Q = H_j (1 − D^z/(D^z + k^z)), habitat suitability degraded by distance-weighted threats

name: Biotope area factor (urban greening factor)
definition: Σ_k w_k × area_k / site area, weights by surface type (e.g. green roof 0.7)

name: Black carbon concentration
definition: Light-absorbing carbon mass concentration (aethalometer)
source: WHO 2012 Health effects of black carbon
law: dC/dt = E/(hA) − kC + advection (box model; Seinfeld & Pandis 2016)

name: Ozone concentration (max daily 8-h mean)
definition: Maximum daily 8-hour mean O₃; peak season mean for long-term exposure
law: dC/dt = E/(hA) − kC + advection (box model; Seinfeld & Pandis 2016)

name: Population near major roads
definition: Share of residents within 150 m of a road carrying > 10,000 vehicles/day

name: Indoor CO₂ concentration
definition: CO₂ as ventilation proxy (≤ 1000 ppm typical guideline)
law: dC/dt = generation/V − ACH (C − C_out)

name: Vibration dose value
definition: VDV = (∫ a_w(t)^4 dt)^(1/4), frequency-weighted acceleration
estimable_from: propagation model from traffic or rail source

name: Artificial night sky brightness
definition: Artificial zenith sky brightness (also mag/arcsec² by SQM)
law: rises with lit area and luminance, about 2% per year (Kyba et al. 2017)

name: Soil contaminant concentration
definition: Concentration of a contaminant (e.g. lead) in topsoil against a guideline value
source: US EPA Regional Screening Levels; ISO 18400
law: dC/dt = deposition − kC (first-order loss)

name: Groundwater standard exceedance share
definition: Share of monitoring wells exceeding drinking-water standards for a contaminant
law: plumes move by advection–dispersion (Fetter 2018)

name: Contaminated site count
definition: Registered potentially contaminated or brownfield sites
law: sites' = new registrations − remediations

name: Pollution exposure disparity ratio
definition: Population-weighted mean exposure of the most deprived quintile / least deprived quintile

name: Cumulative environmental burden score (CalEnviroScreen)
definition: Pollution burden score × population characteristics score, by percentiles

name: Concentration–response coefficient
definition: Relative risk of an outcome per increment of exposure, from epidemiological studies

name: Environmental compliance rate
definition: Share of inspected regulated facilities found in compliance with permits

name: Contaminated site remediation rate
definition: Sites remediated per year / registered contaminated sites

name: Stormwater harvesting share of non-potable demand

definition: Annual change in depth to groundwater at monitoring wells

definition: Sum of 12 metrics of fish or invertebrate assemblage scored 1, 3 or 5

name: Per capita water consumption

name: Waste recovery rate

name: Construction and demolition waste generation
definition: Mass of C&D waste generated per year (also recovery rate)

name: Organic waste diversion rate
definition: Food and garden waste composted or digested / organic waste generated

name: Residual waste per capita

sections: 23 Urban Water, Resources, and Circular Economy

definition: Deaths prevented by walking or cycling volumes (RR 0.89 per 11.25 MET-h/week) × value of statistical life

name: Mental wellbeing (WEMWBS)
definition: 14 positively worded items on feeling and functioning over two weeks, 1–5 each

definition: Sullivan method: Σ L_x (1 − π_x) / l_x over age-specific health-state prevalence π_x

name: Violent crime rate

sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Capital account openness (Chinn–Ito KAOPEN)
definition: First principal component of IMF AREAER restriction dummies
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Trade openness ratio
definition: (Exports + imports) / GDP
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Import dependency ratio
definition: Imports / (production + imports − exports), by product (e.g. food, energy)
source: FAO Food Balance Sheets; Eurostat energy dependency
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Export concentration index (normalised HHI)
definition: H = (√Σ_i s_i² − √(1/n)) / (1 − √(1/n)) over product export shares
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Tariff pass-through rate
definition: Share of a tariff change reflected in tariff-inclusive import prices
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Import penetration exposure (shift-share)
definition: ΔIPW_r = Σ_j (L_rj/L_r) ΔM_j / L_j: local exposure to import growth by industry
estimable_from: shift-share from employment and trade data
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Geopolitical risk index
definition: Share of newspaper articles mentioning adverse geopolitical events and threats, normalised
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Sanctioned-partner trade share
definition: Trade with partners under sanctions / total trade
source: Felbermayr et al. 2020 (Global Sanctions Data Base)
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Reshoring index
definition: Year-on-year change in the manufacturing import ratio (imports from low-cost Asian countries / domestic gross output)
estimable_from: cannot: from trade and output data
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Global Power City Index
definition: Sum of normalised indicators in six functions: economy, R&D, cultural interaction, livability, environment, accessibility
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities

name: Revealed comparative advantage (Balassa)
definition: RCA_cp = (x_cp/Σ_p x_cp) / (Σ_c x_cp/Σ_c Σ_p x_cp)
sections: 29 International Political Economy and Global Cities; 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Cold storage capacity per capita
definition: Refrigerated warehouse capacity / urban population
source: Global Cold Chain Alliance capacity report
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Essential medicine availability
definition: Share of facilities with a basket of essential medicines in stock on the day of survey
law: stock S' = deliveries − dispensing
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Materials shortage indicator
definition: Share of construction firms citing shortage of material or equipment as a factor limiting activity
source: European Commission Business and Consumer Surveys
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Container dwell time
definition: Days import containers stay in the terminal from discharge to gate-out
source: World Bank Container Port Performance Index
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Logistics Performance Index
definition: Weighted mean of six dimensions (customs, infrastructure, shipments, competence, tracking, timeliness) from operator surveys and KPIs
estimable_from: cannot: compiled by the World Bank
law: capability stock accumulates with investment and learning, erodes with turnover (Dierickx & Cool 1989)
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Time to recover (supply chain)
definition: Time for a node or network to restore full function after a disruption
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Days of inventory cover
definition: Stock on hand / mean daily consumption of a critical good
law: S' = deliveries − consumption
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Inventory-to-sales ratio
definition: End-of-month inventories / monthly sales
source: US Census Bureau Manufacturing and Trade Inventories and Sales
law: inventories' = production − sales, steered to a target ratio (Holt et al. 1960)
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Food self-sufficiency ratio
definition: Domestic (or city-region) food production / food consumption, by energy or value
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Construction cost index
definition: Laspeyres index of labour, materials and equipment costs for a standard building
source: Eurostat STS construction cost index; ENR Building Cost Index
estimable_from: input price indices weighted by cost shares
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Input price volatility
definition: Annualised standard deviation of monthly log changes in producer prices of key inputs
sections: 29 Urban Supply Chains and Critical Goods

name: Localisation of knowledge spillovers
definition: Share of patent citations from the same metro / share in a matched control sample
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Urban cost elasticity
definition: Elasticity of urban costs (housing, commuting) with respect to city population (about 0.04)
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Annual congestion cost per commuter
definition: Extra hours of delay × value of time + excess fuel, per auto commuter per year
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: University start-ups formed
definition: Start-up companies formed on licensed university technology per year
law: knowledge production function in R&D inputs (Griliches 1979)
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Technology adoption rate
definition: Share of firms (or households) using a given technology
source: Comin & Hobijn 2010 (CHAT); Eurostat ICT usage in enterprises
law: S-shaped diffusion: dA/dt = (p + qA)(1 − A) (Bass 1969)
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Share of jobs at high risk of automation
definition: Share of jobs with estimated automation probability > 0.7 from task content
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Routine task intensity
definition: RTI = ln(routine) − ln(manual) − ln(abstract) task inputs by occupation, weighted by employment
estimable_from: O*NET task scores × local occupation mix
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Structural change index
definition: SCI = ½ Σ_i |s_i,t − s_i,t−k| over sectoral employment shares
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Regional Innovation Index
definition: Mean of normalised indicators: tertiary education, R&D spending, patents, innovating SMEs, employment in knowledge-intensive activities
sections: 29 Urban Productivity, Innovation, and Structural Change

name: Travel time to international airport
definition: Public transport travel time from the district to the nearest international airport terminal
sections: 30 Ginza Urban Needs and Competing Priorities

name: Land price
definition: Assessed or transacted price of land per m² (official benchmark prices)
source: Japan MLIT Land Price Publication (Chika Kōji)
estimable_from: hedonic or land residual model on transactions
law: land price capitalises rent: P = R/(r − g) (DiPasquale & Wheaton 1996)
sections: 30 Ginza Urban Needs and Competing Priorities

name: International visitor spending
definition: Expenditure by non-resident visitors in the area per period
estimable_from: card transactions by card country; visitor surveys
law: arrivals × spend per visitor; arrivals by gravity in income and exchange rates (Song & Li 2008)

name: Sales share by category
definition: Retail sales in a category (luxury, cosmetics, food, ...) / total sales
source: METI Commercial Dynamics Survey; department store statistics
estimable_from: card transaction data by merchant category

name: Travel party size
definition: Mean number of people travelling together, with shares by party type

name: Shopping conversion rate
definition: Visitors making a purchase / visitors entering (or passing)

name: Weekend to weekday footfall ratio
definition: Mean daily footfall on weekends / mean daily footfall on weekdays

name: Firm survival rate
definition: Share of establishments born in year t still active in year t + k (k = 1…5)
law: hazard of exit falls with age (Jovanovic 1982)

name: Foreign-language service share
definition: Share of shops able to serve customers in at least one foreign language
source: Japan Tourism Agency surveys of inbound reception
law: S-shaped adoption: dA/dt = (p + qA)(1 − A) (Bass 1969)

name: Car-free street hours
definition: Hours per week a street is closed to motor traffic for pedestrians
sections: 30 Ginza Public Space, Street Operations, and Accessibility

name: Walkway capacity
definition: Effective width × maximum unit flow (about 75 persons/m/min)
sections: 30 Ginza Public Space, Street Operations, and Accessibility

name: Taxi waiting time
definition: Mean time a passenger waits at a stand or to hail a taxi
sections: 30 Ginza Public Space, Street Operations, and Accessibility

name: Walking speed
definition: Mean free walking speed of pedestrians over a measured segment (also by density)
law: speed falls with density (fundamental diagram; Weidmann 1993)
sections: 30 Ginza Public Space, Street Operations, and Accessibility

name: Street events per year
definition: Permitted street events (festivals, markets, performances) held per year
sections: 30 Ginza Public Space, Street Operations, and Accessibility

name: Heritage significance rating
unit: levels (exceptional, high, moderate, little) per value
definition: Assessment of aesthetic, historic, scientific, social and spiritual value for past, present and future generations
source: Burra Charter 2013 (Australia ICOMOS); Historic England 2008 Conservation Principles
law: transitions between levels as a Markov chain (Kemeny & Snell 1960)
sections: 30 Ginza Governance, Heritage, and Planning Institutions
